_readme: Every word on the workshop's decor (tools/blender/DECOR_KIT.md). Edit the text freely; keep the keys.
Godot draws it as text (Label3D) when the level loads. Nothing is baked into a texture.
notes: the service-note clipboards (the brief's A12): a title and up to five short lines, wrapped to the paper.
signs: under each hazard sign's triangle, wrapped to the plate. labels: one line on a plate; tags may wrap.
cards: the history cards: title, caption and credit. The credits must stay exact (game/res/textures/decor/PROVENANCE.md).
tests/test_workshop.gd checks that every text fits its paper or plate: shorten it if a check fails.

bay_door.title: BAY DOOR
lines: Opens only for a driven rover.
Never cycle it with the ramp occupied.
Seal check every 10 cycles. Last: cycle 7.

charger.title: CHARGER C-2
lines: Keep feet off the contact plate.
Amber: not in the zone, creep forwards.
Red: no battery, or the rover moved.

signs.vehicle_ramp: VEHICLE RAMP - KEEP CLEAR WHILE AMBER
signs.charger: CHARGER 400 V DC - PROBE MOVES WITHOUT WARNING

apollo12.title: APOLLO 12 - 20 NOV 1969

surveyor3.title: SURVEYOR 3 - LANDED 20 APR 1967 (UTC)
